idea-plugin.name: Copilot Cost Lens
idea-plugin.description:
Copilot Cost Lens — AI Usage & Spend Tracker

Know exactly what your AI coding tools cost you — per repository, per model, per day. 100% local and private. Copilot Cost Lens reads the logs that GitHub Copilot (VS Code Chat and the Copilot CLI), Claude Code and ChatGPT Codex already keep on your machine, attributes every request to the repository you were working in, prices it using the providers' model rates, and shows it all in a live dashboard tool window.

Features

  • Cost per repository — every request attributed to its repo via the git remote.
  • All your AI tools in one ledger — VS Code Copilot Chat, GitHub Copilot CLI, Claude Code and ChatGPT Codex, with a per-provider spend split.
  • Token anatomy & effective $/1M — input, output, cache read and cache write tokens per model, and the blended price actually paid.
  • Dashboard — spend, today's running total, allowance gauge, end-of-month forecast and burn-rate, cost-by-repo and model charts, daily trend and an activity heatmap.
  • Project groups & per-project budgets — roll several repositories into one project; combined receipt PDF and a monthly USD budget per project.
  • Organize — rename repositories, hide noise repos, filter, sort and star; built for 100+ repositories.
  • Receipt PDF export — per repository, per project, or one summary receipt for the whole period.
  • Summary exports — copy the month as a Markdown table or export a pivot-ready per-repository CSV.
  • Budgets & alerts — plan allowance, AI-credit thresholds, monthly budget and runaway-session warnings.
  • Display currency — show amounts in your currency with a manual exchange rate; status bar can show spend, today or credits remaining.

Privacy: everything happens on your machine — no network requests, no telemetry.

Independent open-source project, not affiliated with GitHub, Microsoft, Anthropic or OpenAI.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• 1.22.4 — Fixes under-counted spend. Claude Code subagent and workflow turns are now counted: they are written to <sessionId>/subagents/… rather than the flat project directory, so a scan that only looked one level deep missed the majority of real usage on agent-heavy months. Claude Opus 5 and Sonnet 5 now have prices instead of falling through to the generic fallback rate, which billed Opus 5 at $2/$10 per 1M instead of $5/$25. GPT-5.6 rates refreshed: Luna dropped to $0.20/$1.20, Sol and Terra gained cache-write and long-context tiers. Added Gemini 3.6/3.7 Flash, Grok 4.5/4.6, Kimi K2.7 Code, Kimi K3 and MAI-Code-1.1-Flash.
  • 1.22.3 — Parity with the VS Code edition 1.22.3: ChatGPT Codex as a new data source; VS Code ≥ 1.128 chat-session logs (.jsonl) with exact token counts; rename & hide repositories (with a manage view); today's spend & tokens on the dashboard and in the status bar; status-bar modes (spend / remaining / today) with a 7-day sparkline; display currency with a manual rate; summary receipt for the whole period; Copy Summary as Markdown and Export Summary CSV actions; per-project budgets and runaway-session alerts; Add Storage Root from the empty state; GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna pricing; remote (SSH/dev-container/WSL) workspaces named correctly.
  • 1.13.3 — Full parity with the VS Code edition: export usage as CSV/JSON, AI-credit and monthly-budget alert notifications, a localized dashboard (Czech, German, Japanese), and settings for budget, credit thresholds and extra storage roots.
  • 1.0.0 — Initial release: dashboard, per-repository cost tracking across Copilot Chat, Copilot CLI and Claude Code, project groups, receipts, budgets and the activity heatmap.
